controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: GEBCO_2026 terrain model. Colors show meters above and below mean sea level; relief is shaded for readability. Ocean depths combine measured and estimated terrain. Land includes the ice surface.
controls.summary: GEBCO_2026 modeled terrain. Colors show height and depth relative to mean sea level; ocean depths include estimates.
controls.legendNote: 0 = mean sea level. Shading emphasizes relief; the color scale is unshaded. Some coastal source datums differ.
controls.title: Elevation: GEBCO_2026 land and seafloor heights

controls.title: Night lights: NASA Black Marble 2016 global composite

controls.label: ENSO
controls.description: NASA MUR · 1 km source imagery · 7 Sept 2026. Sea-surface temperature departure from the 2003–2014 average. NASA colors saturate below −3 and at +3 °C. Gray: land, ice, or unavailable imagery.
controls.legendNote: NASA imagery uses 0.1 °C color bins; the NOAA advisory describes the coupled ocean–atmosphere state.
controls.title: ENSO: sea-surface temperature anomalies · 7 Sept 2026
